e.derivation: candidates are one entry per context line in order (shards.py:181-193). end_j = candidate_positions[j+1]-1 when candidate_positions[j+1] > candidate_positions[j]; a collapsed line (shared index) uses its shared token; the last line ends at the token before the one whose decoded text starts the '\n<|qd_context_end|>' delimiter after the last candidate (decode only; line starts are never recomputed). Validity: on every evaluated row, start_j <= end_j < start_{j+1}; if the delimiter search or the monotonicity check fails on more than 0.5% of val pointing rows, arm (e) is void and the failure count is reported, never read as a result.
e.fit: identical to arm (c), same subsample, same lambda grid and selection rule

amendments.recorded: 2026-10-06, after a tokenizer-only census of the val shard and before any tower was loaded or any arm scored. Read: build/needle-span-mac-2026-10-06/cache/avg-val/census.json (sha256 b05069fd78b8c64014e37e3b4880ac06cb6ade95bfc5203f9dd2192da91901d2), which holds derivation counts only (no logits, no scores). The original wording is preserved in commit ee1dfab.
amendments.finding:
1,448 of 7,238 val span rows fail the original last-line rule, all code.defect_class (1,256 pointing, 192 abstain; qa.answer_span 0). The context's last line is whitespace-only with no trailing newline, so BPE merges it with the renderer's '
' before <|qd_context_end|> into one token (per the script agent's message, not in the census file: ' 
' on 1,076 rows and '
 
' on 362, which leaves 10 of the 1,448 unattributed); the token that starts the delimiter IS the last line's start token, and the original rule gives end_last = start_last - 1.
amendments.rule: For the LAST candidate only: if the delimiter's leading newline lies inside the token at start_last, then end_last = start_last, confirmed per row by the token at start_last + 1 decoding to the beginning of '<|qd_context_end|>' (the marker without its newline); a row where that does not hold is a derivation failure, counted and never patched. Every other line keeps the original rule. Monotonicity unchanged: start_j <= end_j < start_{j+1} everywhere, and end_last < the marker's first token.
amendments.void_rule: Arm (e) is void iff derivation failures exceed 0.5% of qa.answer_span/pointing rows (its reading cell, per reading.e_vs_c). The code.defect_class cells report their failure count beside their result; they were already 'reported, not read'.
